LanguageData.CC_Settings_GuestHelp: Guests help with what they love
LanguageData.CC_Settings_GuestHelp_Tip: With Hospitality, whose guests in a good mood help with the colony's work they're skilled at: in everyday times a guest only takes up work they love or that fits who they are (a passion for it, a hard worker's hauling and cleaning, the work their people live by, or work their faith speaks for), and says why the first time. The titled, the proud and their people's heads and heirs do nothing menial, each faith and people keeps its customs, and no guest goes into a bedroom or a cell, does surgery or prisoners' work, or handles the dead. About three hours of everyday work a day, and a guest who is unhappy puts it down. A guest the colony carried in, set free, tended or hosted very well offers a day of their best-loved work before leaving. Working beside a colonist builds friendship both ways, a guest who helped speaks well of the colony at home, and one hurt at the colony's work costs regard with their people. The guest tab shows what each guest would help with and why, with a switch to let them help. Hospitality's own switch for guests helping and its minimum skill still hold. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_GuestHelp: With Hospitality: guests help every day only with work they love or that fits who they are, a few hours a day.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_GuestsPitchIn: Guests pitch in when the colony is in trouble
LanguageData.CC_Settings_GuestsPitchIn_Tip: With Hospitality: whatever their mood, guests help when the colony is in real trouble, with that trouble's work alone and until it's over: they fight a fire near them, carry someone of the colony who is down to a bed, tend the colony's wounded after a raid (with Medicine 4 or more, tending only, never surgery), bring the harvest in before a killing frost (Rimfolk's frost harvest) and cook when the food is about to run out (with Cooking 4 or more). Each says why, and a message names who is helping. The titled, the proud and their people's heads and heirs only pitch in to save a life, and so does a guest who has already worked too long that day. With Hospitality's own "guests helping" switched off, guests still fight fires and carry the downed in, nothing more. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_GuestsPitchIn: With Hospitality: guests help with a fire, a rescue, the wounded, the frost harvest or hunger, whatever their mood.
